records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue decreased by 0.1 percent in the first quarter of 2023 compared to the same period in 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease resulted primarily from decreases in shipments and tonnage, partially offset by increased revenue per shipment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 85.0 percent in the first quarter of 2023 compared to 84.4 percent in the first quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue per shipment increased 7.6 percent to $354.37 per shipment for the first quarter of 2023 as a result of changes in business mix and pricing actions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $99.1 million for the first quarter of 2023 compared to $103.4 million for the first quarter of 2022.
